evidence.quote: We conducted twenty-two semi-structured interviews with software practitioners, in three rounds, focused on collecting their experiences of using LLM tools for software development.
We employed socio-technical grounded theory (STGT) [8] for data analysis.
The first author performed open coding, constant comparison, and memoing.

The data analysis and collection took place over three rounds between October (2024) and September (2025), involving interview participants from Asian, Europe, North America, South America, and Oceania.
